warnings: Reviewed negative references are not an exhaustive negative oracle; precision and F1 are not certified.
Informative references are reported separately and excluded from primary recall.
A finding at a later commit is mapped to the introduction occurrence through unchanged-line lineage; persistence snapshots are duplicates, not new occurrences.
Same-value copies, rotations, reintroductions, and different placements are not conflated with the approved occurrence.
Value-preserving edits are accepted only when the existing lineage block contains the approved value in both parent and child; a reintroduced value starts a new identity.
Removed negative references match only observations at or before their observed removal snapshot.
Verified false-positive alerts and unique verified nonsecret exposures are counted separately; repeated alerts at one approved negative source count once as an exposure.
Unmatched and unverified findings remain in the investigation ledger.

metrics.methodology: count-based filesystem benchmark; not credential-level TP/FP
notes: Count coverage is min(observed, expected) summed over the 44 labeled file rows.
Excess findings are observations above a row's published count and are not false positives.
No credential-level TP, FP, precision, or recall is claimed for this benchmark.

limitations: Source commit is the primary experiment identity; artifact hashes and image IDs are supporting provenance.
A successfully built artifact is not counted as tested unless an applicable suite executed it.
LEGACY COUNT COVERAGE for Leaky Repo is 12.57% (13/44 files); this is an upstream count metric, not verified detection recall.
Levain is a synthetic corpus; counts are not real-world prevalence.
Legacy Leaky Repo score preserves the upstream line-count methodology.
RNC rich score uses the line-level truth manifest and does not claim precision or F1 without a negative oracle.
Upstream risk/informative aggregate categories conflict with source-line review for 6 rows; categories were not reassigned to force the upstream totals.
Leaky Repo history uses the owner-approved 65-occurrence / 53-group source oracle; the filesystem 175-item denominator is not applied.
Reviewed negative references are not exhaustive; history precision and F1 are NOT CERTIFIED.
Informative history references are excluded from primary recall.
Every observed history finding is retained; unmatched and unverified findings require review.
DEFAULT isolation is enforced by omitting --config, clearing known scanner-config environment variables, and executing from an empty run-owned working directory.
The scanner does not expose a machine-readable digest of its embedded default rule set; the harness therefore verifies invocation isolation rather than the rule-file bytes.
Performance measurements used the DEV environment profile; the host was contended/uncontrolled and these timings are not release evidence.
Performance is reported separately from detection accuracy; no weighted combined score exists.
Native, container, and emulated-architecture products are not directly comparable.
Unavailable CPU or memory telemetry is null, never zero.
DEV measurements are contended and not publishable as release evidence.
Levain, Leaky filesystem, Leaky Git and RNC Lab filesystem/Git are separate workloads.
RNC Lab legacy-5x/legacy-10x loads are performance-only and are never scored against the canonical oracle.
Archive extraction and inspected-file coverage are recorded from the declared workload; scanner-internal traversal is not inferred from timing.

truth.note: Every count unit is line-located. Six upstream rows have aggregate risk/informative totals that conflict with the source-line review; categories were not reassigned to force upstream totals.

limitations: Legacy Leaky Repo score preserves the upstream line-count methodology.
RNC rich score uses the line-level truth manifest and does not claim precision or F1 without a negative oracle.
Upstream risk/informative aggregate categories conflict with source-line review for 6 rows; categories were not reassigned to force the upstream totals.
Leaky Repo history uses the owner-approved 65-occurrence / 53-group source oracle; the filesystem 175-item denominator is not applied.
Reviewed negative references are not exhaustive; history precision and F1 are NOT CERTIFIED.
Informative history references are excluded from primary recall.
Every observed history finding is retained; unmatched and unverified findings require review.

summary.methodology: dual: upstream-count legacy + RNC line-level rich

metrics.methodology: count-based filesystem benchmark; not credential-level TP/FP
notes: Count coverage is min(observed, expected) summed over the 44 labeled file rows.
Excess findings are observations above a row's published count and are not false positives.
No credential-level TP, FP, precision, or recall is claimed for this benchmark.
